verdict.rationale: Cekura's own docs describe a Python Metric type that lets users write custom evaluation logic in Python with "complete control". Custom rubrics can also combine multiple metrics with thresholds and AND/OR logic, which directly delivers code-based custom scorers. The evidence is limited to short doc summaries, so depth is unproven. Missing for 10: details on the scorer interface (available inputs such as transcript and metadata, return/output types, runtime and library constraints), and independent or hands-on corroboration of writing and running Python metrics.
